combination_rule: per-timestep, per-state-dimension median across the 5 independently-fitted EchoStateNetwork instances, fed back as the shared next input to all members
rationale: The single-model search (any one hyperparameter+seed combination) could not simultaneously satisfy the original >=0.80 min-VPT-fraction gate AND zero divergence across all 5 registered seeds (Phase C recovery search: 0/96 candidates eligible). Diagnosis showed a clean, uniform 3-good/2-bad seed split at the Part-1 anchor hyperparameters. A per-step median across all 5 seeds (a standard robust-statistics ensembling technique, not a new network architecture) fully eliminates divergence/collapse/numerical failure (0/15 in every case, vs 30/45 catastrophic divergences for individual bad seeds) while preserving strong accuracy (median 68% of the 80-time-unit horizon tracked correctly). This does not clear the original per-rollout 0.80 bar on the single hardest rollout (0.426); it is locked as the best available, most stable chaotic source model, with this limitation stated explicitly rather than the gate being silently weakened.
